instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova Corporation is a boutique hotel group operating 4 properties in historic city centers with a combined 180 rooms. They focus on experiential luxury with in-house curated culinary programs and cultural immersion packages. The company faces stringent local zoning laws regarding expansion and labor, requiring high compliance management to maintain its premium operational standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: They have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats—whether through product differentiation, exclusive partnerships, customer loyalty programs, or service-level improvements that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.
answers.additionalContext: Nova operates in a highly sensitive market where reputation is paramount. They are currently under pressure to demonstrate technological agility while navigating complex local permitting processes associated with hospitality development.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Dynamic Pricing Engine
opportunities.rationale: Utilizing the existing AI recommendation engine to predict guest demand patterns in real-time allows for optimized pricing and package bundling tailored to specific micro-segments. This directly addresses competitive pressure by maximizing revenue from every available booking without requiring massive infrastructure overhaul.

first_actions: Integrate predictive analytics module into current CRM platform
Conduct A/B testing on dynamic pricing models for one property cluster
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in RevPAR by 8% within Q3
milestones: Prototype completion and internal validation: Month 1-2
Pilot launch in one property: Month 3

opportunities.title: Exclusive 'Experience-as-a-Product' Subscription Model
opportunities.rationale: Given the high regulatory environment and micro size, Nova can create a radical moat by packaging their unique cultural immersion and culinary programs into an ultra-exclusive digital subscription service. This creates recurring revenue streams and locks in premium clientele through scarcity.

first_actions: Develop MVP for 'Nova Immersion' digital content platform
Establish partnerships with 3 key local cultural providers
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in subscription services (€10k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 20% conversion rate from physical stay to digital subscription within 6 months

next_steps.action: Form a temporary 'Defense Task Force' to map competitor service gaps and identify immediate operational fixes.
Commission a feasibility study for the radical subscription model, focusing on regulatory hurdles and consumer willingness to pay.

key_weaknesses: Innovation pipeline dependency on sporadic developer availability (high time risk).
Lack of dedicated, specialized R&D talent required to navigate complex hospitality tech.
High operational complexity due to stringent local regulatory compliance requirements across multiple micro-properties.
Over-reliance on owner-alone decision-making leading to potential strategic inertia.
